preconditions.description: The number of forbidden prefix products and the modulus are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden_prefix_products) if n > 0 else True
preconditions.description: If there are forbidden prefix products, each is between 0 and m - 1, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set(forbidden_prefix_products)) == n if n > 0 else True
preconditions.description: If there are forbidden prefix products, they are distinct.

postconditions.description: The length of the sequence is at least 1 and at most 200000.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: Each element of the sequence is between 0 and m - 1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(set(itertools.accumulate(sequence, lambda x, y: (x * y) % m))) == k
postconditions.description: All prefix products of the sequence modulo m are distinct.

postconditions.expression: not any((x * y) % m in forbidden_prefix_products for x in sequence for y in sequence)
postconditions.description: No prefix product modulo m appears as an element of the input list.

postconditions.expression: k == max(len(set(itertools.accumulate(sequence[:i], lambda x, y: (x * y) % m))) for i in range(1, k + 1))
postconditions.description: The length of the sequence is maximized.
